documents.title: Board Meeting Intimation for Board Meeting Intimation For Board Meeting Intimation To Consider And Approve Standalone And Consolidated Un-Audited Financial Results For The Second Quarter And Half Year Ended On 30Th September, 2026 And Any Other Business
Appointment of Company Secretary and Compliance Officer
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: AuSom Enterprise Limited reported a standalone revenue of Rs. 79,910.58 Lakhs and a net profit after tax of Rs. 2,000.94 Lakhs for the financial year ended March 31, 2026. The Board of Directors recommended a final dividend of Re. 1/- per equity share (10%) for the financial year 2025-26.

guidance.claim: The company anticipates achieving a gross consolidated turnover of Rs. 2,50,000 Lakhs during the current year.
guidance.quote: The Company during current year is anticipating to achieve gross consolidated turnover of Rs. 2,50,000 Lakhs and for that necessary efforts have been initiated.

capex_expansion.claim: The company incorporated its wholly-owned subsidiary, Amazo Solar Power Private Limited, and invested Rs. 100.00 lakhs as equity share capital during the year.
capex_expansion.quote: During the year the Company incorporated its Wholly own Subsidiary i.e. Amazo Solar Power Private Limited and invested Rs. 100.00 Lakhs as Equity Share Capital.

capex_expansion.claim: The company incorporated its wholly owned subsidiary company named Amazo Solar Power Private Limited on 26th November, 2024.
capex_expansion.quote: During the year the Company incorporated its Wholly Owned Subsidiary Company namely i.e. Amazo Solar Power Private Limited on 26th Day of November, 2024.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board of Directors recommended a final dividend of Re. 1 per equity share of face value of Rs. 10 each for the financial year 2025-26.
capital_allocation.quote: The Board of Directors at their meeting held on 29th May, 2026, have recommended a Final Dividend of Rs. 1/- (Rupee One only) per equity share of Rs.10/- (Rupees Ten only) each, aggregating Rs. 1,36,23,552 for the F.Y. 2025-26, subject to the approval of Members at the ensuing 42nd Annual General Meeting of the Company and deduction of tax at source, as required under the law.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board of Directors decided to retain the entire amount of profits for the financial year 2025-26 in retained earnings and not transfer any amount to the General Reserve.
capital_allocation.quote: During the year under review, the Board of Directors has decided to retain the entire amount of profits for Financial Year 2025-26 in the retained earnings and not to transfer any amount to General Reserve.

capital_allocation.claim: The company did not accept any deposits from the public within the meaning of Section 73 of the Companies Act, 2013 during the year under review.
capital_allocation.quote: During the year under review, your Company has not accepted any deposits from public within the meaning of Section 73 of the Companies Act, 2013 (“the Act”) read with Companies (Acceptance of Deposits) Rules, 2014.

capital_allocation.claim: The board recommended a final dividend of Re. 1/- per equity share of Rs. 10/- each for the financial year 2024-25.
capital_allocation.quote: The Board recommends final dividend of Rs. 1/- per equity share of Rs.10/- each for the F.Y. 2024-25, subject to the approval of Members at the ensuing 41st Annual General Meeting of the Company and deduction of tax at source, as required under the law.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board of Directors recommended a final dividend of Rs. 1 per equity share for the financial year 2023-24.
capital_allocation.quote: To declare Final Dividend of Rs. 1/- (10%) per Equity Share of face value of Rs. 10/- for the financial year 2023-2024.

capital_allocation.claim: Approval was sought to increase the threshold limit under section 186 to Rs. 3,000 Crore for loans, guarantees, securities, and investments.
capital_allocation.quote: Now, the Company want to increase the threshold limit under section 186 from the Rs. 1,000 Crore (Rupees One thousand Crore only) to Rs. 3,000 Crore (Rupees Three thousand Crore only) for loans / guarantees/ securities / investments to be made exceeding 60% of the Company’s paid-up capital, free reserves and securities premium account or 100% of the Company’s free reserves and securities premium account, whichever is more, but not exceeding sum of Rs. 3,000 Crore (Rupees Three thousand Crore only) in one or more trenches on such terms and conditions as may be decided by the Board from time to time.

management_commitments.claim: The company stated that the proposed dividend will be paid within the statutory time limit, subject to TDS and member approval.
management_commitments.quote: The dividend will be paid within the statutory time limit, subject to applicable TDS to the Members whose names appear on the Company's Register of Members and the beneficial owners in the records of the Depositories, as on the Record date through electronic / other modes as applicable.

management_commitments.claim: The company is anticipating to achieve a gross turnover of Rs. 2,50,000 lakhs during the current year.
management_commitments.quote: The Company during current year is anticipating to achieve gross turnover of Rs. 2,50,000 Lakhs and for that necessary efforts have been initiated.

management_commitments.claim: The company aims to achieve a gross turnover target of Rs. 1,50,000 Lakhs during the current year.
management_commitments.quote: The Company during current year is anticipating to achieve gross turnover of Rs. 1,50,000 Lakhs and for that necessary efforts has been initiated.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
